cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Hello everyone.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: My name's Megan Baker and I'm a recruitment consultant at AVT Recruitment specialists.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Now, our company specialises in positions that involve working in the agriculture and

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: horticulture sectors, so that's fresh food production, garden and park maintenance and so

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: on. And these sectors do provide some very special career opportunities.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: For a start, they often offer opportunities for those who don't want to be stuck with a

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: 40-hour week, but need to juggle work with other responsibilities such as child care –

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: and this is very important for many of our recruits.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Some people like working in a rural setting, surrounded by plants and trees instead of

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: buildings, although we can't guarantee that.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: But there are certainly health benefits, especially in jobs where you're not sitting all

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: day looking at a screen – a big plus for many people.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Salaries can sometimes be good too, although there's a lot of variety here.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: And you may have the opportunity in some types of jobs for travel overseas, although that

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: obviously depends on the job, and not everyone is keen to do it.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Of course, working outdoors does have its challenges.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: It's fine in summer, but can be extremely unpleasant when it's cold and windy.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: You may need to be pretty fit for some jobs, though with modern technology that's not as

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: important as it once was.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: And standards of health and safety are much higher now than they used to be, so there are

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: fewer work-related accidents.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: But if you like a lively city environment surrounded by lots of people, these jobs are

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: probably not for you – they're often in pretty remote areas.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: And some people worry about finding a suitable place to live, but in our experience, this

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: usually turns out fine.
